description: Gitignore and environment protection ensuring GITHUB_TOKEN and other sensitive files are never committed. .gitignore excludes .env, node_modules/, dist/, and starred_repos/. .gitattributes enforces LF line endings and classifies binary files. Git history confirmed clean of .env via `git log --all -- .env`.
spec:
1. Verify .gitignore excludes .env files.
2. Verify .gitignore excludes node_modules/, dist/, and starred_repos/.
3. Verify `git log --all -- .env` returns no results (token never committed).
4. Verify .gitattributes sets LF line endings for text files.
5. Verify .gitattributes marks binary files correctly.
6. Verify .gitattributes contains no duplicate file-pattern entries — each pattern appears exactly once, organized into logical sections (text files, binary files); confirm with `git check-attr -a -- src/index.ts`.
7. Verify environment loading is Bun-native: no dotenv dependency in package.json and no dotenv import or loadDotenv() call in src/ or scripts/ — Bun auto-loads .env files natively. README Configuration section must document creating a .env with GITHUB_TOKEN (Bun auto-loads it) or setting GITHUB_TOKEN via the shell, NOT a dotenv-based workflow.
title: Gitignore and Environment Protection
notes: Revision 1.1.0 (2026-06-11): dotenv removed in favor of Bun-native .env auto-loading; .gitattributes deduplicated so each pattern appears exactly once.
